java_locations.role: A completed named-note command always calls reallyCreateLeaf, even when the body Display is empty. Its body pipeline is subExtract(1, 1), expandsNewline(false), removeEmptyColumns(), then toDisplay().
Removes only indentation columns shared by every nonempty row. Empty and whitespace-only rows remain rows and therefore remain visible Display separators.
Registers named notes, note-on-link, and attached notes in one Description command inventory; bare `note : text` is absent.
Accepts single- and multiline note-on-link commands after a link, attaches a CucaNote to the last link, and returns an error when no link exists.

A factory remains eligible only while every input command is consumed successfully. A failed Class candidate cannot be revived by later scoring; the next registered factory is tried from the full source.

rust_locations.role: Trims a completed body and suppresses note creation when it is empty. It also accepts bare floating notes that Description does not register.
Skips empty lines before consulting the active accumulator, losing Display rows, and lacks the Description note-on-link command despite sharing the same Java factory.
Uses additive subtype scores. A named note and bare note can add enough Class score to select Class even after a component declaration has made that Java factory nonviable.

claimed_invariant: Description note commands are stateful members of one ordered command inventory. A completed named-note opener creates exactly one note entity for every body cardinality, with common indentation removed and body row count preserved. Note-on-link attaches to the most recent eligible link. Any unregistered note command rejects that factory. Factory selection chooses the first factory that consumes the complete source; evidence appearing later cannot restore a candidate already rejected by an earlier command.
causal_divergence: Rust represents named-note bodies as a trimmed String rather than Java's row-preserving Display, so Component deletes empty entities and Deployment deletes blank rows before accumulation. Rust's split Description implementations also omitted note-on-link from Deployment. Independently, detect_uml_subtype treats factory evidence as reversible scores: named and bare notes can outweigh Component after the component declaration has already invalidated Class, producing a successful Class AST for a source Java rejects.
planned_model_change: Preserve multiline bodies as ordered rows until command completion. Remove only common ASCII space/tab indentation using the same all-nonempty-rows rule as BlocLines, retain empty rows, and always materialize a completed named note. Add Deployment's single- and multiline note-on-link command state using the last parsed connection and reject it when none exists. Remove Description's unsupported bare floating-note acceptance. In subtype selection, make Class viability a hard gate once a mixed-only leaf rejects it rather than allowing later score additions to revive it.
perturbation_axes: zero, one, and multiple body rows
leading, internal, trailing, whitespace-only, and NBSP-only rows
note-on-link before any link versus after multiple links
named note followed by registered attached/link note versus unregistered bare note
component declaration order before versus after note commands
renamed note ids and varied link topology
acceptance: Every followup3 Java-valid source is accepted with the same note cardinality, body rows, ownership and link-note presence.
The followup3 Java-invalid component-plus-bare-note source is rejected without constructing a Class diagram.
Empty and blank-only named notes remain entities that later links can target.
Deployment note-on-link rejects without a preceding link and attaches to the latest link when valid.
Fresh held-out inputs vary body shape and command order independently, and an independent checker attempts to disprove the model.
forbidden_approaches: post-render SVG insertion or string surgery
substituting NBSP for only the reviewed blank examples
adjusting subtype weights until reviewed examples happen to route differently
silently accepting note-on-link without attaching it to the connection model
declared_residue: Exact Description-versus-Component/Deployment rendering geometry is covered by their separate layout mechanisms.
Composite note color grammar belongs to the shared ColorParser mechanism.
Other Description commands omitted from either split Rust parser require their own inventory analysis.
Java syntax-error SVG artwork and diagnostic wording are outside parser acceptance parity.
